title: Plan: A cooling-train maintenance campaign
description: Coordinate three A-train assets, specialized crews, independent hold points and a booked inspection window. Compare existing crews with one qualified HX contractor. World supplies equipment basis and current backup-pump observations; work estimates, gates, calendars and deadlines are illustrative assumptions. Planning issues no permits and never operates the plant.

settings.title: A cooling-train maintenance campaign
settings.purpose: Return Service Water A, Component Cooling Water A and Heat Exchanger A through declared release, inspection and test gates while protecting both B pumps; compare specialist coordination, finish time and extra crew cost.
